texts: A storm-surge washed the old graveyard into the Sunken Cove six generations ago.

review.notes: Motion-result shape is right — Theme for the displaced object, Goal for 'into', no Result atom and, correctly, no (LocatedIn sk_graveyard_1 sunken_cove); the inanimate transitive subject keeps Agent, storm_surge gets its genus, and the multi-word name gets one symbol, one Name and the kind atom read off 'Cove' with no 'sunken' atom. 'generation' is the stated word so it is the right BeforeBy unit, but it has no seeded conversion factor, so that gap cannot be compared across units.
